concerns.text: The task list does not include any step that computes and records SHA‑256 checksums for data artifacts (e.g., `data/discovered_envs.json`, `data/sensitivity_report.csv`, `data/evolution_results.csv`, etc.), violating Constitution principle III (Data Hygiene) which mandates checksummed datasets.

No task updates the project’s versioning state file (`state/projects/PROJ-993-llmxive-follow-up-extending-evopolicygym.yaml`) with artifact hashes, breaching Constitution principle V (Versioning Discipline) that requires every artifact to carry a content hash and be recorded.
